Best Banana Bread

Moist and simple.

  • Prep Time: 10 minutes
  • Cook Time: 1 hour
  • Yield: 1 loaf
  • Bread

Ingredients

Wet

  • 3 ripe bananas
  • ⅓ cup melted butter

Dry

  • 1 1/2 cups flour
  • 1 tsp baking soda

Instructions

  1. Mash bananas.
  2. Mix in the rest.
  3. Bake 60 minutes at 350°F.

Notes

Freezes well.
